description: RbNaMg₁₄O₁₅ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pmm2 space group. Rb is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are two shorter (2.35 Å) and two longer (2.50 Å) Rb-O bond lengths. Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent MgO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent MgO₅ square pyramids, edges with ten MgO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent MgO₅ trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-6°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.16-2.45 Å. There are ten inequivalent Mg sites. In the first Mg site, Mg is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted MgO₅ square pyramids that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent MgO₅ square pyramids, corners with two equivalent MgO₅ trigonal bipyramids, and edges with eight MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 16°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 1.92-2.23 Å. In the second Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent MgO₆ octahedra, edges with ten MgO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent MgO₅ trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-4°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.00-2.21 Å. In the third Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with six MgO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, edges with five MgO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent MgO₅ square pyramids, and edges with two equivalent MgO₅ trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 2-15°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.10-2.23 Å. In the fourth Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with six MgO₆ octahedra, edges with seven MgO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent MgO₅ trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 2-8°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.11-2.25 Å. In the fifth Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with four MgO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, edges with six MgO₆ octahedra, and edges with four equivalent MgO₅ trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-5°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.05-2.32 Å. In the sixth Mg site, Mg is bonded in a distorted square co-planar geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 1.98-2.21 Å. In the seventh Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with six MgO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with ten MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-6°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.14-2.21 Å. In the eighth Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with four MgO₆ octahedra, edges with eight MgO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent MgO₅ square pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 3-5°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.01-2.29 Å. In the ninth Mg site, Mg is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted MgO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent MgO₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one MgO₅ square pyramid, corners with three equivalent MgO₅ trigonal bipyramids,  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with seven MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 2-20°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 1.91-2.25 Å. In the tenth Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent MgO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent MgO₅ trigonal bipyramids,  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ octahedra, edges with nine MgO₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one MgO₅ square pyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-5°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.09-2.38 Å. There are eleven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to one Na and five Mg atoms to form ONaMg₅ octahedra that share corners with four ONaMg₅ octahedra and edges with twelve OMg₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-5°. In the second O site, O is bonded to one Na and five Mg atoms to form ONaMg₅ octahedra that share corners with four ONaMg₅ octahedra, corners with two equivalent OMg₅ square pyramids, and edges with twelve OMg₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-6°. In the third O site, O is bonded to five Mg atoms to form distorted OMg₅ square pyramids that share corners with six ONaMg₅ octahedra, corners with two equivalent OMg₅ square pyramids, and edges with eight OMg₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 2-88°. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to six Mg atoms to form OMg₆ octahedra that share corners with six OMg₆ octahedra and edges with ten ONaMg₅ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 2-21°. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to six Mg atoms to form OMg₆ octahedra that share corners with six OMg₆ octahedra, edges with ten ONaMg₅ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent OMg₅ square pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 1-7°. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na and four Mg atoms to form ONa₂Mg₄ octahedra that share corners with six OMg₆ octahedra and edges with twelve ONaMg₅ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-6°. In the seventh O site, O is bonded to six Mg atoms to form OMg₆ octahedra that share corners with six OMg₆ octahedra, edges with eight ONaMg₅ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent OMg₅ square pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-14°. In the eighth O site, O is bonded to six Mg atoms to form OMg₆ octahedra that share corners with six OMg₆ octahedra and edges with twelve ONaMg₅ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-4°. In the ninth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Rb and four Mg atoms to form ORb₂Mg₄ octahedra that share corners with six OMg₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent OMg₅ square pyramids, and edges with eight ORbMg₅ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-40°. In the tenth O site, O is bonded to one Na and five Mg atoms to form distorted ONaMg₅ octahedra that share corners with six ONaMg₅ octahedra, edges with ten ONaMg₅ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one OMg₅ square pyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-22°. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded to one Rb and five Mg atoms to form ORbMg₅ octahedra that share corners with six ONaMg₅ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one OMg₅ square pyramid, and edges with ten ONaMg₅ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-35°.
